highlights: Quarterly operating income was $223 million, a decrease of 1.0% compared to the third quarter of 2025.
Adjusted operating income* was $231 million, a decrease of 0.6% versus the prior year.
Quarterly net income was $158 million, a decrease of 3.4% compared to the prior year.
Third quarter revenues were $1.1 billion, an increase of 6.2% over the third quarter of 2025 with organic revenues* increasing 4.4% compared to the prior year.
Quarterly operating margin was 20.5%, a decrease of 140 basis points compared to the third quarter of 2025.

quotes.text: We are disappointed with our third quarter performance and are acting with urgency to address the challenges impacting our results. We now have a clearer understanding of how the customer acquisition landscape is evolving and are taking concrete steps to optimize our approach.
quotes.by: Jerry Gahlhoff, Jr., President and Chief Executive Officer

quotes.text: Residential customer acquisition remained under pressure in the third quarter.
quotes.by: Will Harkins, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
